messages:
anya: Heads-up: publish job failed because typegen produced a regen-only diff that bumped semver from 0.5.9 -> 0.6.0. Looks like property ordering + a ref rename in generated client.
ci-bot: publish-job-8220 failed: changelog.semver_check failed. Diff: 0.5.9 -> 0.6.0. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/8220
devon: i repro'd locally. sample-app integration flaked on auth/retry, retriggered build used the freshly-built client during publish gating which then regenerated types. The spec itself is unchanged semantically.
mike: two-fold: short-term we should pin the sample-app integration step in publish to the last tagged SDK to avoid circular regen. long-term typegen needs a deterministic normalization pass (stable sort + original-ref hints) before diffing.
anya: can we add an override label for now so releases aren't blocked by generator-only noise?
releases-bot: label `publish/regen-doc-only` created. Applying it requires a release lead ack and a brief justification in #releases.
ci-bot: preserved artifacts at s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/publish/8220. typegen reported: "Reordered properties: Account -> accountId, accountName; Ref rename: ProfileMeta -> ProfileMetadata"
devon: i'll open a pipeline MR to pin the integration artifact to latest-tag (MR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pipeline/pull/234).
mike: i'll open a small typegen PR with stable-sort + an x-original-ref check so cosmetic ref-renames are classified docs-only: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/513. It will emit a normalized-diff marker.
anya: please add a semver-guard rule that consults the normalized marker and treats ordering-only or original-ref-only diffs as docs-only automatically. Also update the release playbook with the override procedure.
devon: will do. Also adding a CI warning if auth/retry tests fail during publish gating to halt and not auto-rebuild.
anya: thanks all. target to merge both PRs before the next release window. If release lead uses the override, log justification in #releases. :thumbsup:
